findings.title: Contract Reset recovery 仍用 post-reset current generation 重建 historical pending Run
findings.problem: 新 E1 spec 已明确 recoverContractResetPendingRun 必须基于 target pending Run 的 persisted entry lineage；122 production implementation 仍在 isContractResetOnlyPendingDrift 中调用 deriveSemanticInputs(current snapshot, context.action, descriptorsFromContext(context))。deriveSemanticInputs→collectContractRefs 又调用 computeResetAwareLineage(snapshot,...).artifact，因此 Reset 正确排除旧 proposal/apply generation 后，旧 pending Apply/revise-apply recovery 仍会要求 current generation producer，重现 `apply has no immutable propose producer generation` deadlock。
findings.contractRef: specs/flowkit-formal-fact-reader-and-persistence Requirement: Contract Reset recovery 必须保持 narrow admission；docs/flowkit-self-hosting-bootstrap-and-migration.md persisted-entry invariant
findings.invariant: historical pending Run 的 entry truth 来自其 persisted context/inputRef/producer-review lineage；Contract Reset 只改变 currentness，不能迫使 recovery 用新 generation 重新解释旧 Run。
findings.requiredOutcome: 为 reset recovery 增加严格 historical reconstruction：以 target context.inputRef、consumed review result、reviewed producer ResultRefs及其 persisted contract/Owner refs重建原始 entry semantic view；只将 current applicable Contract Reset作为允许的唯一差异。缺失、歧义、hash mismatch或 mixed drift 均 fail closed，不得 fallback 到 current-generation producer lookup。
acceptance: synthetic approved proposal/review→pending apply→Contract Reset 后，旧 proposal generation 已 non-current 仍可由 official recovery取消为 superseded-by-owner-contract-reset
同样覆盖 pending revise-apply historical lineage
recovery 不要求 post-reset current propose producer
missing/ambiguous historical refs、multiple pending 与 mixed semantic drift 全部 fail closed

findings.title: v5 exact resume 没有重验 applicable Owner/contract semantic drift
findings.problem: resumeRun 对 v5 target 只验证 persisted context/ActionPackage identity，并对 Apply/revise-apply 检查 entry→current workspace 的 declared mutation；它不比较当前 applicable Owner facts、contract/declaration source或其它 external semantic inputs。inspectPreparedRun 对 schema v5 又优先直接调用 resumeRun。因此 pending v5 Run 在 Owner Contract Reset 或 contract drift 后仍可能被报告/返回为 resumable。
findings.contractRef: specs/flowkit-lean-run-and-action-package Requirement: pending self-drift 必须基于 persisted entry identity；design.md exact resume boundary；docs/flowkit-self-hosting-bootstrap-and-migration.md
findings.invariant: resume 不重新用 post-action worktree定义 entry identity，但必须从 persisted entry refs重验当前 external/unowned semantic facts；Action-owned mutation不是 self-drift，Owner/contract/declaration-source drift必须 fail closed。
findings.requiredOutcome: exact resume 必须以 persisted entry identity为 anchor，重新验证当前 applicable Owner/contract/declaration-source及其它非 Action-owned semantic inputs；发生 drift 时 fail closed。若唯一 drift 是 Contract Reset，应允许现有 narrow recovery path进一步分类，而不是把 Run误判为 resumable。
acceptance: v5 pending Run 后新增 Contract Reset，resumeRun 不得返回 pending/resumable
contract/declaration source 或其它 external semantic input drift 同样 fail closed
declaration覆盖的正常 Apply mutation仍可 exact resume，不产生 self-drift
inspectPreparedRun 对 reset-only v5 pending 能进入正确 recovery-required/not-resumable projection，而非 resumable

findings.title: 新 verification selection 的 passed 状态仍可由预置 marker 注入，canonical Verification 证据被 renderer 丢弃
findings.problem: 122 在 terminal admission 才从 actualChangeSet 派生 verification selection，但 matched selection 的 verificationStatus 直接读取 admission 前 current verification.md 的 status marker；随后 Core renderer 覆盖 verification.md，只保留 overall marker、selected modules/capabilities/scopes 与 actualChangeSet。当前路径没有基于刚派生的 exact scopes 执行/接纳 Verification-owned results，也丢失 canonical Verification record 必须包含的每项检查适用性、命令/方法、状态、摘要、结果引用/环境说明与 Full Test 状态。因此预先写入 passed marker 即可让 immutable selection record 固化 passed，而没有 exact evidence 证明该 selection 已通过。
findings.contractRef: supersedes E1-RA-005 remaining status-lifecycle concern；02-change-execution-loop-delivery-implementation-reference-v3.md §13.5；canonical flowkit-formal-fact-reader-and-persistence Change Verification record requirement；design.md Decision 8
findings.invariant: verificationScope 必须先由 Core post-action observation确定；passed/failed 必须来自 Verification authority 对该 exact scope 的结果。verification.md 仍是完整 Change Verification 正式记录，不能把 caller/Author 预写 status marker 当作新 selection 的通过证据。
findings.requiredOutcome: 闭合 selection→Verification result→canonical verification record 的时间与 authority 顺序：Core 先确定 exact selection，passed/failed 只能由该 selection 的 Verification authority result产生；canonical verification.md 保留 contract 要求的完整检查证据，并与 immutable per-Run selection identity可复验绑定。不得接受仅有预置 status marker 的新 selection 为 passed。
acceptance: 预先存在 passed marker、但没有 matching selected-check results 时，v5 Apply publication不得产生 passed Verification authority
selected scope 的 passed/failed/not-applicable 均有 deterministic authority path；not-applicable 仍只来自 closed proof
canonical verification.md 包含 scope、每项检查适用性、command/method、status、summary、result ref/environment、Full Test 状态和 overall status
review-apply 读取的 passed/failed generation exact-bind current selection 与对应 Verification evidence
